Committee: Judiciary
Sponsor: Smitherman
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 03/15/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 177 as introduced proposes a Constitutional Amendment which, if ratified, would establish the 9-member Alabama Court Cost Commission to review existing laws regarding court costs and proposals for new court costs. This would increase the obligations of the State General Fund by an estimated $2,200 per day for each meeting of the Commission.
This bill will increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2023.
Tom Whatley, Chairperson
Judiciary

Committee: Judiciary
Sponsor: Smitherman
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 03/17/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 177 as introduced proposes a Constitutional Amendment which, if ratified, would establish the 9-member Alabama Court Cost Commission to review existing laws regarding court costs and proposals for new court costs. This would increase the obligations of the State General Fund by an estimated $2,200 per day for each meeting of the Commission.
This bill will increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2023.
As amended and reported by the Committee on Judiciary increases the membership of the Commission to 11 members. This could increase the obligations of the State General Fund by an additional $600 per day for each meeting of the Commission.
Tom Whatley, Chairperson
Judiciary

Committee: County and Municipal Government
Sponsor: Wood (R)
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 02/08/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 146 as introduced allows the Alabama Water Pollution Authority to extend the repayment period of loans issued by the Authority from 20 years currently to a period which does not exceed the expected design life of the project, if required or permitted by the Federal Clear Water Act. This could increase the total amount of interest paid by a city, county, or instrumentality thereof over the repayment period by an undetermined amount dependent upon the terms of the loan. This bill will not otherwise directly affect state or local funding.
Reed Ingram, Chair
County and Municipal Government
